findings.current: The three men stared at me in utter confusion.
findings.defect: The draft identifies all three people as men, but the group includes Song Song.
findings.rationale: The source says 세 사람, “three people,” and does not alter their identities or genders.
findings.replacement: All three of them shot me bewildered looks.
findings.source: 세 사람의 당황한 시선이 우수수 날아와 꽂혔다.

findings.defect: 뚱이 is the Korean name for Patrick Star, not a generic claim that the speaker is fat. The current rendering loses the cultural-reference joke.
findings.rationale: The exchange echoes Patrick Star’s well-known denial gag, making Patrick the appropriate English localized name.

findings.current: The moment the cool spear shaft filled my grasp, Im Yeongjun shouted like he was screaming for his life.
findings.defect: “For his life” adds a specific implication that Im Yeongjun is terrified for his own survival. The source only describes his shout as sounding like a scream.
findings.rationale: 비명처럼 describes the sound and intensity of the shout without supplying a motive for it.
findings.replacement: The moment the cool spear shaft filled my grasp, Im Yeongjun shouted, his voice rising almost to a scream.
findings.source: 서늘한 창대가 잡힘과 동시에 임영준이 비명처럼 외쳤다.

findings.current: “Yes. There were slight discrepancies, possibly because he used an artifact affected by Illusion magic, but there is no doubt.”
findings.defect: “Affected by” is vague and misstates the construction: the artifact had Illusion magic placed on it.
findings.rationale: 마법이 걸린 describes an artifact bearing an enchantment or spell, not merely one incidentally affected by magic.
findings.replacement: “Yes. There were slight discrepancies, possibly because he used an artifact enchanted with Illusion magic, but there is no doubt.”
findings.source: “네. 일루전(Illusion) 마법이 걸린 아티팩트를 썼는지 약간의 차이는 있었지만 확실합니다.”

findings.current: The moment I cut through the iron bars with the hand force gathered in my palm and stepped into the yard, a blaring siren rang out with the sensation of passing through a soft membrane.
findings.defect: “Hand force” is unnatural and does not clearly convey condensed Murim energy formed around his hand; “rang out with the sensation” is also an awkward attachment.
findings.rationale: 수강 is a condensed martial force formed at the hand, while the second clause presents the membrane-like sensation as accompanying the alarm.
findings.replacement: The moment I sliced through the iron bars with qi condensed around my hand and stepped into the yard, a blaring siren rang out as I felt as though I’d passed through a soft membrane.
findings.source:
손에 맺힌 수강(手罡)으로 철창을 가르며 정원으로 발을 디딘 그 순간.

부드러운 점막을 통과한 듯한 기분과 함께 요란한 사이렌 소리가 울려 퍼졌다.

findings.current: Inside the minivan you could see anywhere, Song Song muttered doubtfully as she watched the footage Butler Kim had recorded with magic.
findings.defect: “The minivan you could see anywhere” is an unnatural Korean-syntax calque.
findings.rationale: 어디서나 볼 수 있는 characterizes the minivan as commonplace rather than literally emphasizing where it can be seen.
findings.replacement: Inside an utterly ordinary minivan, Song Song muttered doubtfully as she watched the footage Butler Kim had recorded with magic.
findings.source: 어디서나 볼 수 있는 승합차 내부, 김 집사가 마법으로 녹화한 영상을 보던 송송이가 미심쩍다는 표정으로 중얼거렸다.

summary: One identity error and several actionable fidelity, cultural-reference, mechanism, and terminology issues.
